           BARNES KEITH RANCH’S RESPONSE TO SOAH ORDER NO. 24

       On June 1, 2026, SOAH Order No. 24 entitled “Ruling on Intervenor Notices Granting

Leave For Late-Filed Testimonies, and Dismissing Intervenors (the “Ruling”). In that Ruling,

Barnes Keith Ranch is once again identified as a party that did not timely file testimony or a

statement of position. Contrary to that Ruling, Barnes Keith Ranch timely filed the testimony of

Robert V. Keith on May 13, 2026, as Interchange Item Number 4304. A copy of Mr. Keith’s

testimony and a copy of the Interchange Filer are attached as Exhibit “A”. The first page of the

testimony states that it is being provided on behalf of Barnes Keith Ranch.

       Barnes Keith Ranch maintains that it has preserved its intervenor party status and moves

for SOAH Order No. 24 to be corrected by removing Barnes Keith Ranch from the listing of

Intervenors being dismissed.

 Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                                                    1

                                             I.   INTRODUCTION

Q.       PLEASE STATE YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS.

A.       My name is Robert V. Keith. My primary address is 116 Bella Vista Trail, Georgetown,

         Texas 78633. My San Saba address is Box 4005 CR 452, San Saba, Texas 76877.

Q.       ON WHOSE BEHALF ARE YOU TESTIFYING?

A.       I am testifying on behalf of Barnes Keith Ranch.

Q.       WHAT IS THE PURPOSE OF YOUR TESTIMONY?

A.       I am addressing LCRA Transmission Services Corporation’s (LCRA) application to amend

         its certificate of convenience and necessity (CCN) for a transmission line in Gillespie,

         Llano, San Saba, Burnet and Lampasas Counties (the Gillespie to Newton 345-IV

         Transmission Line). Specifically, I address the impact that constructing the proposed line

         would have on the Barnes Keith Ranch.

Q.       ARE YOU A DIRECTLY AFFECTED LANDOWNER?

A.       Yes. Barnes Keith Ranch is a 12,445 acre family-owned working ranch in San Saba

         County. Barnes Keith Ranch owns property along proposed Links J22, and J26 and the

         Ranch will be directly impacted by their proposed links.


                                      II.   DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY

Q.       PLEASE DESCRIBE YOUR PROPERTY.

A.       Our property consists of 12,445 acres located along the Colorado River in San Saba and

         Cherokee Counties. The property is beautiful Texas Hill Country land, with twelve (12)

         miles of Colorado River frontage. This scenic portion of the Colorado River is home to

         abundant wildlife.


Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                     2

                                                                           Exhibit "A" - Page 3 of 11 Pages
 Q.       HOW LONG HAVE YOU OWNED YOUR PROPERTY?

A.       The property was purchased by my great grandmother in the 1920s and has been in our

         family since that time. My children will be our family’s fifth generation to own the Ranch.

Q.       HOW IS YOUR PROPERTY USED?

A.       We use the property for both recreational and business purposes. Our primary businesses

         are cattle and hunting. In terms of the recreational use, we have regular family gatherings

         at our San Saba home. We also regularly entertain business clients at the Ranch.

Q.       PLEASE EXPLAIN THE BUSINESS USE OF YOUR PROPERTY.

A.       For almost one hundred (100) years, our family has conducted a highly respected cattle and

         hunting operations on the Ranch.       Our cattle business is primarily a cow-calf and

         replacement cow operation. The herd consists of 400 to 600 mother cows depending on

         range conditions. Our hunting operation consists of guided hunts and season leases.

         Hunters have access to over 10,000 acres of prime hunting territory. Hunters from around

         the world travel to our Ranch to participate in our hunting program. Due to an ideal habitat

         for wild game, our Ranch boasts a wide variety of hunts and game selection. This selection

         includes trophy whitetail deer, wild feral hogs, Rio Grande turkeys, and other native and

         exotic game. The Ranch was one of the first ranches in Texas to have exotic animals and

         has been under professional wildlife management since 1983. We have worked very hard

         to enhance the land for livestock and wildlife.




Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                      3

                                                                            Exhibit "A" - Page 4 of 11 Pages
 Q.       WHAT IMPROVEMENTS HAVE YOU MADE TO THE PROPERTY?

         Since our original acquisition, we have been active managers of our property and have

         invested substantial sums in improving our property to enhance both its recreational and

         business use.

Q.       PLEASE EXPLAIN.

A.       As part of our long range plan for the Ranch, we strive to make the property better for

         agriculture and wildlife. We have used professional consultants and courses of study to

         help us achieve this plan. Fencing, grazing practices, water supplies, supplemental feeding

         and harvest practices are all part of this plan. We have built an extensive network of roads,

         many miles of high and low fence, numerous permanent houses, barns, pens, water supplies

         and over one hundred (100) feeders. In addition, we have purchased many vehicles and

         equipment.

         To assist with the maintenance of the Land and care for the agricultural and wildlife, we

         have three (3) employees that live on the Ranch with their families full-time. We also use

         contract labor on a regular basis. We are fully committed to maintaining and improving

         the land.

Q.       DO YOU HAVE ANY HABITABLE STRUCTURES ON YOUR PROPERTY?

         Yes. Our family home, constructed by my great grandmother in 1928, is located by the

         bank of the Colorado River. In addition to the family home, three (3) of our employees

         and their families live in three (3) separate houses on the Ranch. There is also a cabin that

         used by guides and contract laborers.




Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                       4

                                                                             Exhibit "A" - Page 5 of 11 Pages
          The property also includes the hunter’s lodge, which accommodates up to fifteen (15)

         people. We recently completed a full remodel of the hunter’s lodge, replacing everything

         but the exterior walls. This remodeling project amounted to an investment of $50,000.00

Q.       HAVE YOU EVER SEEN PROTECTED OR ENDANGERED SPECIES ON YOUR

         PROPERTY?

A.       Yes. On a regular basis, I see bald eagles and golden eagles. In its letter filed on

         December 9, 2009, the Texas Parks & Wildlife Department (“TPWD”) also acknowledges

         the existence of numerous state-protected and federally endangered wildlife – such as Bald

         Eagles (federally protected from take and state-protected), the Golden-Cheeked Warbler

         (federally endangered) and Black-Capped Vireo (federally endangered) in the area in

         which the family property is located.

Q.       IS THERE ANYTHING ELSE NOTABLE ABOUT YOUR PROPERTY OR THE

         AREAS BORDERING YOUR PROPERTY?

A.       Yes. As stated before, part of our property borders a portion of the beautiful Colorado

         River. This area is known as the Canyon of the Eagles. Many people visit this area each

         year to enjoy the Colorado River’s natural beauty and abundant wildlife. This portion of

         the Colorado River is also traveled by a popular ecological cruise called the Vanishing

         Texas River Cruise, which departs from Lake Buchanan – just south of our property line –

         and passes right by our property up the Colorado River. Additionally, just north of our

         property line and in direct sight is Post Oak Ridge State Park.




Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                     5

                                                                           Exhibit "A" - Page 6 of 11 Pages
                         III.      POSITION REGARDING PROPOSED ROUTES

Q.       WHAT IS YOUR POSITION REGARDING THE ROUTES PROPOSED BY

         LCRA?

A.       The Region in which our Ranch is located represents one of the most scenic ecologically

         intact landscapes remaining in the Central Texas Hill County. On January 9th of this year,

         Governor Abbott spoke at the opening of Post Oak Ridge State Park, calling it “a great day

         for the future of Texas”. Yet two of the proposed transmission routes would permanently

         damage the very views and natural resources that make this new State Park so valuable.

         Post Oak Ridge State Park is directly north of our Ranch and in the final application

         Oncor/LCRA places both Route Links J22 and J26 directly through our Ranch and within

         the Park’s primary viewshed. TPWD personnel familiar with the new Park have indicated

         that these routes would ruin the best view from the Park. In the direct testimony from Casey

         D. Petty, P.E., Witness for Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA

         Transmission Services Corporation, he selects Route 894 as the route that best meets the

         requirements of the Texas Utilities Code and the Commission’s Substantive Rules. Link

         J22 is within Route 894. In his testimony he said that no miles of ROW are within the

         foreground visual zone of any park/recreational area. PIJCT has defined foreground visual

         zone to be within 0.5 mile radius from the observer. Link J22 is approximately 0.7 miles

         radius from the Post Oak Ridge State Park and its best observer location along is south

         boundary. The 0.5 mile radius was established before anyone considered the visual

         intrusion of these massive 765kv towers. Also, the specific topography of the Park and our

         Ranch render that measurement meaningless in the context of the goals of avoiding visual

         intrusion. In point of fact, Link J22 will pass through the middle of the view of the Park

         and actually pass directly over Post Oak Falls. TPWD officials and others who are familiar
Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                      6

                                                                            Exhibit "A" - Page 7 of 11 Pages
          with the Post Oak Ridge State Park and who have been on site should be asked their

         opinions rather than relying of USGS maps, aerial photography and whatever other means

         were used by Mr. Petty.

                                      IV.     CONCLUSION

         For the reasons set forth, Route Links J22 and J26 must be rejected as the location(s) of the

         final transmission routes.


                                        V.     SIGNATURE


                                               Respectfully submitted,


                                               _________________________________
                                               Robert V. Keith




Direct Testimony of Robert V. Keith                                                                       7

THE STATE OF TEXAS                             §

COUNTY OF JEFFERSON                            §

      BEFORE ME, the undersigned authority, on this day personally appeared the person
known by me to be Robert V. Keith, who, after being duly sworn by me, stated as follows:

       1.      My name is Robert V. Keith. I am over eighteen (18) years of age, am of sound
mind and competent to make this Affidavit. I have personal knowledge of every statement
contained in this Affidavit, and every statement contained herein is true and correct and based on
my own personal knowledge.

        2.     I make this Affidavit in support of my testimony on behalf of the Barnes Keith
Ranch in the above-captioned proceeding. Attached hereto and made a part hereof for all purposes
is my Direct Testimony and Exhibits, which have been prepared in written form for introduction
into evidence in SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349.

        3.          I hereby swear and affirm that my answers contained in the testimony are true and
correct.



                                                    Robert V. Keith

      SUBSCRIBED AND SWORN TO before me on this the ____ day of May, 2026, to certify
which witness my hand and seal of office.
